finding.text: Requirements 2/check: the Docs tab screenshot at 1200 was not taken. shots/ holds the Dictate Overview at 400 and 1920, not the drawer's Docs tab, so nothing shows pipeline.md first in the list (sheet.png; session.jsonl shots line).

Stale doc: `ux/Dictate/doc/docs-tab.md` line 3 still says the row holds "settings, architecture, Whisper, the Debug tab, the voice architecture". DictateDocs.DOCS is now pipeline, map, voice architecture, wake policy, debug tab, settings. architecture.md and whisper.md were dropped, and the task folder says nothing about why (requirement 2: "say what you dropped and why").

No dropped-docs record: nothing in session.jsonl, the readme or the diff says which docs were dropped or demoted and why. The readme still links `doc/architecture.md` ("the decisions that hold today") without noting it left the Docs tab.

Unindexed task folder: `pipeline-doc/` has no summary or report for mastermind-dictation-2 and no findings `log` lines. session.jsonl holds only assign, commit and shots. A fresh agent cannot tell what was checked or what is left, such as the "line numbers read 2026-10-25" claim or whether the pipeline's file:line pairs were verified. The card path in requirements.md (`2026/10/25/cards/chat-show-when-your-words-reach-the-assi`) does not resolve in this tree.

The new overview card links `md/doc/pipeline/`, but both shots log a 404 (layout.json `errors`). The log does not say which URL failed, and the shots were taken before pipeline.md was committed to the served tree, so the card's link is unverified.
Overview card at 400 and 1920 reads well, but the new card sits first in a grid of six and pushes Decisions to the end. Fine, since the owner asked for it first.
